seoDescription: Cococabana is an Oceanside rooftop restaurant and bar with brunch, cocktails, coastal views, and private event options.
heroText: Rooftop drinks, brunch, coastal energy, and private events in Oceanside.

heroImage.alt: Coco Cabana rooftop bar aerial view over Downtown Oceanside, CA

welcome.imageAlt: Coco Cabana rooftop lounge seating with tile wall, rattan pendants, and Oceanside views
welcome.title: Where Oceanside
welcome.text:
Perched above The Brick Hotel at 408 Pier View Way, Coco Cabana is a
          rooftop bar built around its own identity — relaxed, elevated, and entirely its own.
          Stop in for a cocktail, settle in for the evening, or make it the start of a night
          out in Downtown Oceanside.

bar.imageAlt: Coco Cabana open-air rooftop bar — marble counter, bar stools, hanging greenery, Oceanside views
bar.title:
Open Air.
Full Bar.
bar.text:
Caribbean-inspired cocktails crafted from scratch, cold drafts, and a full bar program
        under open skies — four stories above Downtown Oceanside.

brunch.imageAlt: Coco Cabana mimosas — Campo Viejo cava flights with copper flamingo, marble table, tile wall
brunch.title:
Brunch on
the Rooftop

view.imageAlt: Sunset viewed from Coco Cabana rooftop through glass railing, palms silhouetted against orange sky
view.imagePosition: absolute inset-0 w-full h-full object-cover object-[center_65%]
view.title: The View
view.text:
Four stories above Downtown Oceanside, the views stretch past the rooftops and palm
          canopy all the way to the Pacific. Sunsets here are something else entirely — settle
          in early and watch the sky change over the water.

cabana.imageAlt: Coco Cabana lounge area with pink daybeds, geometric tile wall, and Oceanside city views
cabana.imagePosition: absolute inset-0 w-full h-full object-cover object-center
cabana.title: Lounge Seating
cabana.text:
The cabana's signature lounge seating is designed for settling in. Rattan pendants
          overhead, geometric tile walls, pink daybeds, and unobstructed views of the Oceanside
          skyline — this is the corner of the rooftop you'll want to claim early.

liveMusic.imageAlt: DJ set at Coco Cabana with crowd on the rooftop
liveMusic.title:
DJ Fridays
& Saturdays
liveMusic.text:
Live DJ sets every Friday and Saturday night. The rooftop transforms after dark —
        cocktails, open air, and the Oceanside skyline as your backdrop.

          Reach out to start planning.
